sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Light Magic: Lamp of Avior
spells.note: The user surrounds himself with light and launches it: Lumiere's (Lemiel's) spell. The existing page.

spells.name: Light Magic: (travelling on a beam of light)
spells.note: The wiki says he shapes light into a large arrow that becomes a beam of light along which he flies. The mod's Light Speed page is the nearest existing page; it is not a wiki-named spell.

spells.name: Light Magic: Lamp of Avior Gloria
spells.ja: アヴィオールの灯・栄光
spells.note: The Mana Zone version of the Lamp of Avior (Multiversal Omnipedia via the search summary). The existing page.

planned.name: Light swords and explosive bursts of light
planned.note: Described but not named by the wiki; the Light Sword of Judgment page belongs to Patolli, so no page.

planned.name: Demon-Dweller Sword: Protecting Light
planned.note: A union spell with Licht's sword magic; needs the Anti-Magic sword, not built here.

notes: Mode 0 of the Light book (Light Sword of Judgment) cannot be hidden, so it stays in his grimoire although it is Patolli's spell. He has no new page: all three of his spells already exist.
